Project Control Engineer – Power Conversion 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
 Jetzt bewerben Mitarbeitende bewerben sich hier Diesen Job teilen
 The opportunity 
 At our Competence Center "Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, and grid interconnections.
 Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency.
 To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems.
 If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity.
 How you’ll make an impact 
 Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation
 Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams
 Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews
 Develop and implement control software, including testing on real-time simulation platforms
 Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site
 Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery
 Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation
 Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management
 Your background 
 Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor’s or Master’s, from a university or university of applied sciences)
 Hands-on experience with MATLAB / Simulink is essential
 Strong knowledge of process control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI)
 Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus
 Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage
 Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time)
 Fluency in English and German
 More about us 
 Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
 Additionally, you can expect:
 Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics
 Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications
 A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work
 Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business
 Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team

**Dein Aufgabengebiet**
* Entwicklung von leistungsstarker Elektronik für die Steuerung und Regelung von Leistungshalbleitern und Leistungskomponenten im Automotive-Umfeld

* Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung durch Kitazuschuss
* Wir bieten Sonderurlaub, Jubiläumszuwendungen uvm

Job Description:
 In order to support our Gust Engineer Team, Airbus is looking for a
 Junior Gust Loads Engineer (d/f/m)
 Are you passionate about aircraft physics?
Are you keen to master the way we compute external loads acting on the vehicle due to manoeuvres, flight in turbulence, landing impact, ground-handling?
Do you like to work in an empowered manner?
Do you enjoy connecting people and collaborating with many different interfaces?
This job will give you the opportunity to work internationally with several internal flight physics departments and with teams located in Europe and India.
We are a team of multicultural and passionate engineers who perform the gust calculations for overall aircraft design for all aircraft types. Our team is involved from a very early design stage until certification and also in-service support. We are responsible for running build model activities such as finite element modelling, creating mass and aerodynamics models. We perform gust loads calculation, including failure cases, and deliver to internal interfaces. On top, we are deeply involved in research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, model based system engineering, automation and machine learning.
 Your location
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
 Our Benefits for You
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities
 As Gust Engineer, you will contribute to:
 Optimize the global design of Airbus products during the concept phases 
 Contributing in building Aerodynamic/Mass/Finite Element model based using Airbus in-house tools 
 Compute gust loads based on CS25 requirements 
 Develop key competences in the areas of loads and aeroelastics along with the required methods and tools 
 Actively support us as a new member of our team on our journey 
 Desired Skills And Qualifications
 You have a Master degree or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent 
 You have experience in Gust and Aeroelastic modelisation and analysis 
 You have experience in overall aircraft design and basic competencies in flight loads calculation and flight mechanics 
 You have experience in aeroelasticity methods and are experienced in coding using Python and/or Matlab 
 You have a strong knowledge on MSC.NASTRAN, TAU-CFD 
 You are passionate to understand physical aspects and to use your engineering judgement 
 You are a highly motivated, proactive and open-minded person with a great sense of initiative 
 You are keen to deepen your technical knowledge while enjoying to work in a multicultural team 
 Your English is at negotiating level whereas German language skills would be beneficial 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

## Hardwareentwickler (m/w/d)
**Spannende Aufgaben**
* Entwicklung elektronischer Baugruppen, Geräte und Systeme für verschiedene Anwendungsbereiche
* Analyse von System- und Hardwareanforderungen
* Erarbeitung von Konzepten und Schaltungsdesigns
* Definition der Hardwarearchitektur
* Dimensionierung elektronischer Komponenten
* Validierung der entwickelten Hardware sowie Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Tests
* Unterstützung bei der Integration der entwickelten Hardware
**Das erwartet dich bei uns**
* Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
* Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
* Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
* Bei uns kannst du eigene Ideen einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten
* Prämienprogramm für Empfehlungen von neuen Kolleg:innen
* Mehr als der GVP, wir bieten Sonderurlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Jubiläumszuwendungen uvm.
* Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung durch Gleitzeitregelungen
* Networking und einfach Spaß haben bei Teamevents, Weihnachtsfeiern oder Sommerfesten
**Das bringst du mit**
* Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Elektrotechnik - alternativ eine Ausbildung mit Berufserfahrung im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbares
* Berufserfahrung in der Hardwareentwicklung
* Gute Anwender:innenkenntnisse in Entwicklungs- und Simulationstools wie z. B. Altium, Matlab/Simulink
* Breite Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von analogen und digitalen Schaltungen, ASICs und FPGAs
* Praxiserfahrung in den Bereichen Embedded und/oder Leistungselektronik

**Ihre Aufgaben**
- **Testplanung:** Sie erarbeiten und ergänzen Systemtestpläne.

- **Qualitätsstandards:** Sie haben bestenfalls bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit Normen wie ISO26262.
- **Versionierung:** Idealerweise sind Sie routiniert im Umgang mit Git als Versionskontrollsystem.

- **Weiterentwicklung:** Fachspezifische Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- **Eigenständigkeit:** Selbstverantwortlicher Arbeitsplatz mit spannenden Projekten, in denen Sie Ihr Knowhow und Ihre Ideen einbringen und wesentlich zum Erfolg beitragen können

items.jobDescription:
About The Role
 This role is about investigating and troubleshooting technical issues found in Geely vehicles. It involves reproducing software and hardware problems, collecting and analyzing vehicle data logs to identify root causes, and tracking issues through JIRA. The position also supports the handling of warranty parts and ensures issues are progressed and reported in a timely manner. Overall, it combines hands-on vehicle diagnostics, problem-solving, and coordination with engineering teams to help improve vehicle quality and reliability.
 What You Will Do
 Execute static & dynamic issue replication testing for both HW and SW issues, related to all Geely brand vehicles served (Geely, Volvo EX30, Polestar 4)
 Retrieve required logs from the vehicle to support root-cause analysis (CAN, FR & LIN logs, DHU logs, TCAM logs etc…)

Job Description
 Change the world. Love your job.
 Do you strive to understand how electronics work, and enjoy debugging and solving technical problems? Here's your chance to innovate for the future! Applications Engineers in Power Management IC's at Texas Instruments (TI) are a highly-motivated, synergistic group with great team spirit and a strong commitment to the customer as a technical expert. In this role, you will provide technical solutions to customers that will ultimately go into consumer products like smartphones, PC peripherals, personal medical devices, electric cars, e-bikes and much more. You'll also provide technical support and engage with customers to help define new products and opportunities for future product development. We have a strong customer commitment and a great team spirit. If you are looking for an interesting and challenging position with a wide range of exciting responsibilities, you've come to the right place
Our applications engineers engage with customers both virtually and in person to help and solve their toughest technical challenges. They understand customer's needs, develop end equipment expertise, help to define our products and be part of what's next! You will work in the applications team of a DC/DC Buck Converter & Controller Product Line to gain a deep understanding of specific products within the business unit - how to position them, typical problems/barriers, how to test/debug and how to solve customer problems at a system level hat focus on ease-of-use and add value to their solution. These experiences are hands-on, technical problem-solving focused with the goal of helping you to create compelling solutions and win business for TI.
As an Applications Engineer, you will also get exposure to other roles such as: Design, Systems and Field Application Engineering, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing and Project Management through formal learning, projects and on-the-job development experiences that will help you broaden your knowledge and accelerate your growth and success at TI.
 Some of your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
 Schematic and PCB design of analog circuits
 Assembly and test of electronic circuits
 Analyzing circuit designs in simulation using different simulation tools
 Design, setup and debugging of test circuits for DC-DC converters & Controllers
 Calibration of measurement setups
 Test of application circuits for DC-DC converters & Controllers
 Software development such as GUI, driver…etc depending on the specific product
 Perform measurements for characterizing new DC-DC converters according to internal standards
 Customer visit and debugging issue in their lab, explaining how specific products functions..etc
 Qualifications
 Minimum requirements:
 Master degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology, Bio-Medical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Electrical and Computer Engineering or related field
 Preferred Qualifications
 Knowledge and understanding of power electronics (examples include: DC/DC power, data converters, op-amps, sensing, etc.)
 Understanding of schematics, layouts and BOM ( including passive selection )
 Experience in Spice simulation
 Experience in PCB layout design 
 Experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, along with soldering and debugging skills
 Open to travel and visit customers when it is needed
 Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills
 Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, German is good to have! 
 Excellent presentation skills
 Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery
 Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
 Ability to build lasting, influential relationships, both inside and outside the organization
 Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment
 Ability to take initiative and drive for results
 Ability to influence decisions through a sense of urgency and competitive drive
 About Us
 Why TI?
 The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us.
 Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture .
 At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings .
 About Texas Instruments
 Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com .
Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment.
If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.
 About The Team
 TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship, immigration status or national origin. However, if TI determines that information access or export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit you from working in this position without first obtaining an export license, TI expressly reserves the right not to seek such a license for you and either offer you a different position that does not require an export license or decline to move forward with your employment.

About Us
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 Overview
 Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.
 Ideal candidate
 A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.
 Skills Required
 PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)
 Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets
 Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking
 Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets
 Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)
 Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency
 DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly
 Component selection and BOM management
 Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus
 Responsibilities:
 Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections. 
 PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints. 
 Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management. 
 Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan. 
 Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes. 
 Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed. 
 EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections. 
 Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up. 
 Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding). 
 Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions. 
 Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications. 
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.jobDescription:
Die Hochschule Landshut ist eine dynamische Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften mit den Studienschwerpunkten Technik, Wirtschaft, Soziales, Gesundheit und Medien und in praxisorientierter Lehre, Forschung sowie Transfer national und international hervorragend etabliert. Sie bildet rund 5.350 Studierende aus und beschäftigt derzeit 450 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter.
Das Technologiezentrum Energie der Hochschule Landshut in Ruhstorf sucht zum 01.01.2027 eine/-n
wissenschaftliche/-n Mitarbeiter/-in (w/m/d)
(Befristet, in Vollzeit)
zur Mitarbeit im Forschungsprojekt „NIBAT“, gefördert durch das Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie. Im Rahmen unseres interdisziplinären Forschungsprojekts untersuchen Sie nitrilbasierte Elektrolytbestandteile für Batterien. Sie charakterisieren geeignete Systeme, bewerten deren elektrochemische Eigenschaften und untersuchen Zusammenhänge zwischen molekularer Struktur und Wirkung im Elektrolyten.
Ihre Aufgaben:
 Planung, Entwicklung, Durchführung und systematische Auswertung elektrochemischer Tests für Zellen im Labormaßstab inkl. Zellbau
 Nutzung computerchemischer Methoden zur Unterstützung des Materialscreenings
 Verknüpfung experimenteller Befunde mit theoretischen Erkenntnissen und Ableitung übergeordneter Struktur-Wirkungs-Zusammenhänge der untersuchten Nitrile
 Aufbau und Inbetriebnahme eines Gasanalytik-Teststands
 Aufbereitung der Ergebnisse für Projektberichte, Präsentationen und wissenschaftliche Veröffentlichungen
 Kommunikation und Koordination der Aktivitäten mit den industriellen Projektpartnern
 Anleitung von studentischen Abschlussarbeiten und wissenschaftlichen Hilfskräften
 Unsere Anforderungen:
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master / Magister / universitäres Diplom) im Bereich Chemie, Materialwissenschaften, Elektrochemie oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
 Erfahrung und Interesse an experimenteller Laborarbeit mit elektrochemischen Systemen und Batteriezellen
 Kenntnisse elektrochemischer Messmethoden, wie galvanostatische Lade-/Entladetests und Cyclovoltammetrie
 Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an Laborarbeit und der Auswertung und Interpretation experimenteller Daten
 Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit innerhalb eines internationalen Teams
 Wir bieten Ihnen:
 Eine interessante, abwechslungsreiche und herausfordernde Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Umfeld
 Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle sowie Telearbeitsmöglichkeiten an einer familienfreundlichen Hochschule
 Vielfältige Sozialleistungen nach den Regelungen des öffentlichen Dienstes, insbesondere zusätzlicher Altersversorgung sowie eine Jahressonderzahlung nach den Vorgaben des TV-L
 Herausragende Angebote im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement und in der Gesundheitsförderung

Company Description
 Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.
 Job Description
 Role Overview:
The Peripheral & Variant Lead is the technical leader responsible for peripheral blockset development and scalable device-variant enablement within Renesas Hardware Support Packages (HSPs). This role delivers production-quality Simulink peripheral blocks (e.g., ADC, PWM, UART, CAN) built on the foundation layer and drives consistent, automated enablement across MCU variants through well-defined architecture, validation strategies, and standardized integration patterns.
The role ensures tight alignment with core platform dependencies and works closely with the foundation team to deliver maintainable, customer-ready solutions. Candidates are expected to have strong MATLAB/Simulink Model-Based Design and Embedded Coder experience. Prior MATLAB HSP or custom blockset development experience is preferred but not mandatory. Candidates with advanced MATLAB/Simulink and embedded code-generation experience will receive a structured 1–2 month ramp-up on MATLAB HSP architecture, target library development, and peripheral block implementation.
 Roles And Responsibilities
 Lead the development of peripheral blocksets (ADC, PWM, UART, CAN, etc.) leveraging foundation components and established integration patterns.
 Drive scalable device-variant enablement by defining validation strategies and automation frameworks that efficiently support multiple Renesas MCU families.
 Define block architecture, coding standards, and integration patterns to ensure consistency, reusability, performance, and long-term maintainability.
 Review and optimize IO Builder / MATLAB System Object implementations for performance, usability, and customer experience.
 Collaborate closely with the foundation team to maintain alignment with core dependencies and release compatibility.
 Develop deep expertise in MATLAB HSP architecture, target library development, peripheral block implementation, and associated target-enablement workflows. 
 Qualifications
 Qualifications:
 B.Tech / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or related field with 10+ years of experience in embedded systems and strong experience in peripheral driver development.
 Strong hands-on experience with MATLAB/Simulink and Model-Based Design for production embedded software development.
 Strong experience with Embedded Coder and code-generation workflows, including configuration, generation, integration, build, and deployment of generated C/C++ code on embedded targets.
 Experience integrating MATLAB/Simulink-generated code with existing embedded software, legacy C/C++ code, BSP/SDK, MCAL, AUTOSAR stacks, or equivalent production embedded software architectures.
 Experience developing application models and troubleshooting issues across the model, generated code, embedded software, and target hardware boundaries.
 Proven ability to design scalable architectures for multi-variant device support, automation, and validation/regression testing.
 Senior Staff-level technical leadership demonstrated through architecture ownership, rigorous technical reviews, mentoring, and cross-team influence.
 Prior experience developing MATLAB Hardware Support Packages, target libraries, custom Simulink blocksets, or equivalent target-enablement frameworks is preferred, but not mandatory.
 Added Advantage
 Experience creating custom blockset packages, peripheral libraries, MCAL, or CDD for semiconductor solutions. 
 Familiarity with IO Builder / System Object patterns and performance tuning in model-based workflows. 
 Experience with MATLAB HSP development, Simulink custom blocks, MATLAB System Objects, target registration/configuration, or embedded target support. 
 Experience with AUTOSAR Blockset, Embedded Coder, SIL/PIL, model/code verification, or production AUTOSAR code-generation workflows. 
 Experience with Renesas MCU peripherals, FSP/MCAL, BSP/SDK integration, or equivalent semiconductor MCU ecosystems. 
 Additional Information
 Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier . With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.
At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.
We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.
Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?
Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

About VAT Group 
 At VAT, we change the world with vacuum solutions. As the world’s leading supplier of high-performance vacuum valves, we have been driving innovation for more than 60 years. With over 3,200 employees worldwide, we operate from our headquarters in Haag, Switzerland, with manufacturing sites in Switzerland, Malaysia and Romania, as well as sales and service hubs around the world. We are guided by our passions: integrity, teamwork, customer centricity, and innovation – always working together as #oneVAT. 
 Joining us means becoming part of a passionate, international team where your voice is heard, your ideas matter, and your career growth is supported. 
 Our team in Haag, Switzerland is looking for you:
 Our products are key components in any semiconductor processing tool worldwide. To extend our market leadership in advanced pressure control for sub-2 nm chip production we want to strengthen our team with experienced engineers and researchers with passion for control theory, dynamic system modelling and optimization-based control
 You will be an integral part of our R&D team to develop industry leading gas control systems for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. You are a great fit for our team if you want to work on advanded control methods on embedded control hardware, enjoy taking initiative and exploring new approaches to intelligent control, and want to validate your ideas hands-on in experimental and industrial environments.
 RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 Develop novel and differentiating control algorithms for fast and nonlinear processes using advanced model-based, optimization-based and data-driven control methods using VAT’s existing gas delivery and pressure control technology 
 Develop and validate physics-based, data-driven and hybrid dynamic system models using system identification methods 
 Design and simulate control concepts in MATLAB Simulink, deploy them on embedded control platforms and verify their performance on on experimental test setups
 Plan, execute and document experiments (DoE) and analyze results in a systematic manner
 Take technical ownership of development projects, including requirements and specification alignment with key stakeholders, concept development, rapid prototyping, experimental verification and validation on final products 
 Cooperate among cross-functional teams of experts within VAT R&D organization and external technology partners
 Occasional on-site support of newly developed applications/products at customer site.
 Engineering Degree (MSc or PhD) in mechanical or electrical engineering, control engineering, mechatronics or similar
 4+ years’ experience in developing advanced control algorithms for physical or industrial systems
 Strong foundation in control theory, dynamic system modelling, system identification and numerical optimization 
 Knowledge of machine learning and optimization based control methods for dynamic systems 
 Practical experience implementing and deploying control systems on embedded hardware 
 Advanced proficiency in MATLAB Simulink
 Practical experience with C/C++ and Python coding 
 Knowhow in fluid dynamics and vacuum systems is advantageous
 Hands on and systematic engineering mindset, strong analytical problem-solving and team spirit
 Interested? Then we look forward to receiving your application 
You can expect a dynamic and successful company where innovation, courage, fairness, openness and transparency are encouraged and your ideas are welcome.
 Our commitment to inclusion, fairness and equal opportunities 
 We believe in meaningful careers, continuous learning, and equal opportunities for everyone to drive our innovation and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. If you have concerns, our compliance channel is available at our website. All reports are handled with strict confidentiality and in accordance with our Code of Conduct.

 Innovative Technologien begeistern Sie und Ihr ausgeprägter Gestaltungswille treibt Sie an, neue Lösungsansätze aktiv voranzubringen
 Analytische Problemlösungskompetenz und ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein zeichnen Ihre Arbeitsweise aus. Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen Ihnen zudem einen flüssigen Austausch im internationalen Arbeitsumfeld

 Flache Hierarchien und ein dynamisches Team, in dem Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe, offene Kommunikation und kurze Entscheidungswege selbstverständlich sind​

 Umfangreiches Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsangebot, das Ihnen individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet und Ihre fachlichen sowie persönlichen Fähigkeiten gezielt fördert

**Ihre Karriere in der Umsetzung moderner Systeme in der Luft- und Raumfahrt.**
Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING arbeiten Sie an der Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Inbetriebnahme technischer Systeme in der Luft- und Raumfahrt. Sie begleiten Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur Validierung und bringen Ihr Know-how direkt in die Praxis ein – im Werk sowie bei Anlagen im In- und Ausland.
### **So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei**
- **Konzeption:** Sie entwickeln Lösungen für Energie-, Steuerungs-, Antriebs- und Sicherheitssysteme.
- **Umsetzung:** Sie realisieren technische Konzepte gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams
- **Koordination:** Sie steuern Unterlieferanten und unterstützen Montageteams
- **Inbetriebnahme:** Sie nehmen Anlagen und Subsysteme im Werk sowie vor Ort in Betrieb
- **Tests:** Sie führen Validierungen und Funktionsprüfungen durch
- **Fehlersuche:** Sie analysieren Störungen und setzen gezielte Maßnahmen zur Behebung um
- **Internationalität:** Sie begleiten Projekte weltweit – je nach Projektphase auch über mehrere Wochen
### **Das bringen Sie mit**
- **Qualifikation:** Studium der Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder vergleichbar
- **Fachinteresse:** Kenntnisse in Automatisierungs-, Antriebs- oder Regelungstechnik
- **Programmierung:** Erfahrung mit SPS/PLC-Systemen, idealerweise Beckhoff TwinCAT 3
- **Zusatzkenntnisse:** Erfahrung mit weiteren SPS-Systemen oder Programmiersprachen (z. B. Python) von Vorteil
- **Systemverständnis:** Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu erkennen und Lösungen abzuleiten
- **Praxis:** Grundverständnis elektrischer Anlagen und Schaltpläne sowie Hands-on-Mentalität
- **Sprachen & Mobilität:** Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie hohe Reisebereitschaft

- **Attraktive Konditionen:** Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- **Zukunftssichere Projekte:** Mitarbeit an Projekten im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und industrielle Anlagen
- **Dynamisches Team:** Kollegiales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
 What You'll Do
 Own stress analysis and structural integrity for booster hardware, from early concept sizing through to qualified, flight-ready designs. 
 Analyse booster structures and components under extreme thermal, pressure, vibrational, and mechanical loads, using hand calculations and finite element (FE) methods. 
 Define and manage booster load cases across the full life cycle, including manufacture, handling, transport, storage, test, and flight. 
 Carry out structural safety assessments for hardware containing energetic materials, including failure mode assessment, safety factors and margins, and the effects of structural failure. 
 Produce the structural evidence for booster safety cases and hazard analyses, working closely with the Propulsion Systems Engineer and the HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) and Quality teams. 
 Assess the structural effects of manufacturing defects, non-conformances, and design changes, and give clear, timely disposition advice. 
 Define the structural requirements for proof, acceptance, and qualification tests, and correlate test results with analysis. 
 Work closely with design, propulsion, thermal, and systems engineers, to make sure designs are safe, analysable, and lightweight. 
 Take part in design and safety reviews, and present analysis results and margins clearly to engineering leadership and customers. 
 Write clear, traceable stress reports and safety assessment documentation under configuration control.
 Who You Are
 A hands-on Stress Engineer with experience analysing high-load flight hardware, pressure vessels, or rocket and booster structures.
 Degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering (or related discipline); a postgraduate qualification in structural mechanics or a related field is a plus.
 Strong grounding in structural mechanics, including strength, stability, fatigue, fracture, and thermal stress, with confidence in both hand calculations and FE analysis.
 Experience with FE tools (e.g. Abaqus, MSC Nastran, Ansys) and turning results into practical design and safety decisions.
 Experience producing structural safety assessments or safety case evidence in a regulated or safety-critical industry such as aerospace, defence, nuclear, or pressure systems.
 Experience with energetic or pressurised systems, and the safety requirements that apply to them, is a strong advantage.
 Programming skills (e.g. Python or MATLAB) for automation, post-processing, and test correlation are an advantage.
 Comfortable making sound engineering judgements with incomplete data in fast‑moving, prototype‑heavy environments, without compromising on safety.
 Fluent English is essential; German is an advantage.
 What We Offer
 A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
 Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
 High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
 A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
 A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
 Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.
 At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: SW Application Engineer 
 Job Description: 
 Build your brand. Tell your story. Take advantage of a rare opportunity to start from the ground up and build something great. We are looking for technology game changers to lead Stellantis into a fundamental transformation within the automotive industry. Technology is going to disrupt the automotive industry significantly in the next decade and our organization is seeking high potential candidates to transform the company with a focus on the customer experience.
 Stellantis’ Software Organization (PDT) was established to build the most captivating experiences in the latest frontier of Automotive Technology.
 As part of that foundation, we are seeking passionate engineers to execute the porting of application software features from legacy controllers to the next generation vehicle controller.
 You will develop software Body Domain features and drive the innovation related to these features. You will be able to shape the future of mobility.
 Ensuring and maintaining the highest quality and developing according to safety and quality standards are a fundamental part of your daily work.
 You will be part of a global SW driven engineering organization with a modern state of the art agile culture. Collaboration is key.
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Degree in mechatronics, automotive engineering, robotics, computer science, electrical, electronic engineering or comparable education
 Embedded software development experience in in automotive environment (5-8 Years)
 Experience in model-based development with e.g. Matlab/Simulink
 Experiences in the development of vehicle features in at least one domain
 Familiarity of Automotive Product Development Process like ASPICE and ISO26262
 Analytical & interdisciplinary thinking, problem solving skills
 Self-motivated and drive for results
 Self-reliant, well-structured and organized working style
 Good communication skills and the ability to interface with internal stakeholders
 Good team working skills in an international environment
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with authoring ASIL compliant software code
 Experience working within an Agile development process
 Unit Testing experience with any of the tools eg: BTC, RTRT, Reactis for C.
 Static Analysis experience with any of the tools eg : Polyspace
 Familiarity with AUTOSAR (Classic & Adaptive) concepts, architecture, specifications and configuration tools
 Please share your profiles to careers.swxindia@stellantis.com with below details:
 Total yrs. of exp:
 CCTC:
 ECTC:
 NP:
 At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation and disability. Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future.
 By submitting your application, you are accepting our privacy notice: https://www.stellantis.com/en/privacy

Who we are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role
 At Helsing we use simulation to train and test autonomy at scale, long before anything touches real hardware. You will be part of a team that owns a system for simulating large-scale 3D worlds containing hundreds of actors, rendered in real time.
 You will work on the internals of the simulation stack, including modelling of vehicles and other actors, integration of high-fidelity models from domain experts, sensor and environment simulation, networking, and interfacing with other components in a distributed system.
 Typical examples of day-to-day responsibilities include: 
 Building and maintaining simulation platform internals: subsystem architecture, replication and multiplayer, performance profiling, and the interfaces used by other systems to orchestrate simulation.
 Composing simulated platforms from sensor, communications, situational awareness, effector, and control-loop models, and reasoning about the underlying physics such as flight dynamics, rigid-body behaviour, collision, and line of sight.
 Owning the trade-off between fidelity, throughput, and engineering cost, choosing the right point for each use case and validating the result against subject matter experts, integration tests, or downstream outcomes.
 Integrating 3D models, animations, and effects from our Content Engineers into the simulation.
 Investigating simulation bugs in order to bridge the gap from our simulation to a reference model.
 The day-to-day
 You will write production code that shapes both the simulation platform and the models running inside it, and you will decide how each piece of work is validated.
 You will also translate mission requirements from subject matter experts into reusable simulation models, and make sure those models remain useful to the teams using simulation as part of their stacks.
 You will contribute to high-impact projects and collaborate with people across many teams and backgrounds.
 You should apply if you
 Have built real simulations well beyond toy projects, especially with game engines such as Unreal, Unity, or Godot, including gameplay frameworks, replication, and profiling tooling.
 Write production code and bring proper software engineering practice into simulation work, including version control discipline, resolving ambiguity, and designing for the long term rather than the next demo.
 Reason fluently about the trade-off between physical fidelity and simulation throughput.
 Translate input from domain experts into models and behaviours, and know when real-world fidelity is needed and when it is expensive noise.
 Judge a simulation by what it enables rather than by whether it passes its tests, and treat a simulation that quietly misleads its users as a serious failure.
 Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to have
 Experience with entity-component-system architectures or agent-based modelling.
 Experience with distributed simulation standards such as HLA, DIS, RPR-FOM, NETN, or FMI.
 Background in physics-heavy simulation, for example CFD, finite element methods, multi-body dynamics, or trajectory and 6DoF modelling.
 Experience with RF, electronic warfare, or radar simulation, including propagation and signal processing chains.
 Familiarity with reinforcement learning environment APIs, or with software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop validation.
 Experience with Rust, CUDA, or MATLAB and Simulink.

items.jobDescription:
Tätigkeitsbeschreibung: 
 The department "Mechanism Products Germany" in Immenstaad is looking for a 
 Mechanism Drive Electronics (MDE) System Engineer for mechanism development (d//f/m) 
 The Mechanism Products Germany department develops and supplies products for space mechanisms (https://www.airbus.com/en/products-services/space/equipment/mechanisms). As an MDE System Engineer, you will work in an interdisciplinary team with international customers and suppliers through all phases of a project- from tendering and development to commissioning and final delivery of the product. 
 Your location
 At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains. 
 Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facility 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Act as Development Responsible for complex Mechanism Drive Electronics (MDE) solutions. Technical management, monitoring, and steering of external hardware subcontractors, ensuring compliance with technical specifications 
 Responsibility to derive, write and manage technical requirements and detailed specifications for MDE from upper-level or subsystem assembly specs 
 Analyze external supplier proposals, author technical evaluations and support Tender Evaluation Boards (TEBs). 
 Inject MDE expertise into commercial and institutional proposals to secure new programs 
 Support the preparation and technical definition of the department’s mechanism technology roadmaps 
 Dynamically support multiple space programs in parallel, providing a fast-paced environment with a global technical overview across various architectures 
 The role offers the opportunity to execute hands-on activities (e.g. BB, EM) in laboratory conditions 
 This role offers a pathway to take over or develop into the Product Owner position for Mechanism Drive Electronics (MDE) with technical leadership and responsibility for broader product lifecycle, roadmap, and strategic definition 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a relevant engineering discipline 
 6+ years of professional experience in high-reliability electronics design, experience with space-mechanism drive electronics or precision motor control is an advantage 
 Direct experience in hardware design and architecture in compliance with ECSS (European Space Standards) and MIL-STD (Military Standards) incl. knowledge of electrical component selection 
 Working knowledge of VHDL (Virtual Hardware Description Language) to supervise developments and implementation according to ECSS processes 
 Proven capability to technically steer external subcontractors 
 Experience to author and/or review electrical design data packages (e.g. PDR (Preliminary Design Review), CDR (Critical Design Review), MRR (Manufacturing Readiness Review) milestones) 
 Knowledge of motor control electronics design for Stepper and Brushless DC (BLDC) motors, including commutation strategies and motor control methodologies 
 Experience integrating standard space communication protocols, e.g. MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire, and CAN / CAN-Bus 
 General knowledge of position feedback system/sensor technologies (e.g. digital/analog encoders, hall sensors, switches, potentiometers) and closed-loop architectures (e.g. PID, micro-stepping strategies) 
 Experience with MATLAB and Simulink for the mathematical modeling is an advantage 
 Fluent in business English (spoken and written) and German skills preferred 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

 Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter Weichmagnetische Werkstoffe (all genders)
 Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft ( www.fraunhofer.de ) ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.
 Das Teilinstitut Dresden des Fraunhofer-Instituts für Fertigungstechnik und Angewandte Materialforschung IFAM mit derzeit ca. 120 Mitarbeitenden ist spezialisiert auf die Grundlagen- und Anwendungsforschung zur lösungsorientierten Werkstoff- und Technologieentwicklung für innovative Sinter- und Verbundwerkstoffe, Funktionswerkstoffe sowie zellulare metallische Werkstoffe für die Energietechnik, Mobilität und Medizintechnik. In der Energietechnik kommt der Wasserstofftechnologie eine tragende Rolle zu. Sind Sie bald mit dabei?
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Ihre Neugier führt Sie in die Abteilung Pulvermetallurgie und in unser Team „Weichmagnetische Werkstoffe“. Hier begleiten Sie praxisnahe Forschungsprojekte zur Entwicklung von Magnetkernen für effiziente elektrische Maschinen, Leistungselektronik und moderne Energieumwandlungs-systeme. Die Entwicklungsprojekte von der Werkstoffidee über den Herstellungsprozess bis zum funktionsfähigen Prototyp werden öffentlich gefördert und/oder von Industriepartnern beauftragt. Dabei erhalten Sie viel Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene wissenschaftliche Themen aufzubauen und diese von der ersten Idee bis zum Forschungsprojekt und industriellen Transfer weiterzuentwickeln.
 Sie entwickeln neue Werkstoffe und pulvermetallurgische Fertigungstechnologien für weichmagnetische Komponenten aus Pulvern, Bändern und weiteren Ausgangsmaterialien und überführen vielversprechende Ansätze in funktionsfähige Prototypen.
 Sie untersuchen die Zusammenhänge zwischen Herstellungsprozess, Gefüge und magnetischen Eigenschaften und bewerten neue Werkstoff- und Prozesskonzepte durch umfassende magnetische Charakterisierung und Benchmarking.
 Sie entwickeln eigenständig Forschungs- und Entwicklungsideen, leiten daraus Versuchs-programme ab und setzen diese gemeinsam mit unserem interdisziplinären Team wissen-schaftlich und technisch um.
 Sie akquirieren und leiten öffentlich geförderte sowie bilaterale Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte und arbeiten dabei eng mit Industriepartnern und wissenschaftlichen Einrichtungen im In- und Ausland zusammen.
 Sie vertreten unsere Forschung gegenüber Kunden und Projektpartnern und präsentieren Ihre Ergebnisse in Projektberichten, wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und auf nationalen und internationalen Fachkonferenzen.
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium der Werkstoffwissenschaft, Materialwissenschaft, Physik, Verfahrenstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, Promotion von Vorteil
 idealerweise Kenntnisse auf dem Gebiet magnetischer Werkstoffe, der Pulvermetallurgie oder funktioneller Werkstoffe sowie Erfahrung in der Materialcharakterisierung

Description
 About the Role:
 We are seeking an experienced Medior Autosar Software Engineer to join our embedded delivery team as our On-Site Resident Engineer in Munich. In this role, you will act as the crucial technical link between our distributed engineering teams and the client’s R&D engineering teams. You will be responsible for hands-on error analysis, debugging directly on physical electronic control units (ECUs), and vehicle-level troubleshooting on commercial vehicle platforms (heavy-duty trucks and buses, including ICE and battery electric vehicles).
 What We Offer:
 Exposure to high-impact, series-production automotive platform software for global commercial vehicle brands.
 Direct collaboration with tier-1 R&D leaders in Munich and an international nearshore delivery team.
 Deep technical growth in next-generation commercial vehicle architectures, functional safety (ASIL D), and electrification platforms. 
 Requirements
 Must-Have:
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent experience.
 Experience: 4+ years of hands-on embedded software engineering experience in the automotive domain.
 Microcontroller Knowledge: Practical experience with 32-bit automotive microcontrollers, specifically Infineon AURIX TriCore (TC3xx / TC2xx) architectures and register-level programming.
 Debugging Tools: Proficient in using Lauterbach Trace32 debuggers, JTAG/DAP interfaces, and bus analysis tools/CAN Cases (e.g., Vector CANoe/CANalyzer or equivalent).
 Software Stacks: Solid understanding of Classical AUTOSAR architecture (BSW), Complex Device Drivers (CDD), MCAL configuration, and C/C++ embedded programming.
 Toolchain Familiarity: Hands-on experience with automotive compilers (e.g., HighTec TriCore GCC) and configuration tools (e.g., ETAS ISOLAR-B, Elektrobit Tresos).
 On-Site Availability: Ability to be on-site at the Munich area facilities on short notice to support test rigs and vehicle integration.
 Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for technical documentation and international team collaboration). Working proficiency in German (mandatory for on-site lab, workshop, and vehicle testing coordination).
 Nice-to-Have:
 High-Voltage Qualification: Valid High-Voltage Safety Certification for working on prototype electric vehicles.
 Functional Safety: Working knowledge of ISO 26262 (ASIL B / ASIL D) workflows and coding practices.
 Test Frameworks: Experience writing unit/integration test cases using Catch2 or Google Mock, and running static code analysis with Helix QAC. 
 Job responsibilities
 Hardware & Bench-Level Debugging: Perform hands-on root-cause analysis and defect elimination directly on target control units and hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) test benches using Lauterbach debuggers.
 Target ECU Architecture: Analyze, debug, and patch issues across series production ECU platforms on Infineon AURIX TriCore.
 Software Maintenance & Development Support: Develop and adapt Classical AUTOSAR Basic Software (BSW) components, Complex Device Drivers (CDDs), and MCAL drivers in C/C++.
 Vehicle & Prototype Testing: Assist in reproducing intermittent bugs and validating software fixes directly on vehicle prototypes and system test benches; execute ECU flashing and bus measurements (CAN, LIN, Ethernet).
 Client Coordination & Agile Cadence: Represent the engineering delivery team in weekly on-site synchronization meetings and daily agile standups (SAFe/Scrum) alongside client technical coordinators and verification teams.
 Quality & Static Analysis: Ensure delivered patches conform to strict automotive quality gates, achieving zero mandatory MISRA violations and creating automated unit tests.
 What we offer
 Empowering Projects: With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives.
 Empowering Growth: We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success.
 DE&I Matters: At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace diversity . We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, fostering an inclusive and empowering work environment.
 Career Development: Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm.
 Comprehensive Benefits: In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.
 Flexible Opportunities: At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.
 About GlobalLogic
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

items.jobTitle: Qualifizierungsstelle (Promotion) im Forschungszentrum Digital AI-Driven Sustainable Value Chains (Daisi)
items.jobDescription:
QUALIFIZIERUNGSSTELLE (PROMOTION) IM FORSCHUNGS­ZENTRUM DIGITAL AI-DRIVEN SUSTAINABLE VALUE CHAINS (DAISI) Die Hochschule Osnabrück ist die forschungsstärkste Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften in Niedersachsen. Im Rahmen ihrer strategischen Exzellenzinitiative „Transformation Through Excellence in Applied Sciences“ (TExAS) stärkt sie herausragende Forschungsprofile in drei neuen Forschungszentren, die projektbasiert für den Zeitraum von drei Jahren aus Mitteln der VolkswagenStiftung gefördert werden.
 Für das neue Forschungszentrum „Digital AI-Driven Sustainable Value Chains“ (DAISI) suchen wir Sie als wissenschaftl. Mitarbeiter*in im Bereich Digitale Zwillinge, Robotik und Künstliche Intelligenz. In einem Team von 12 Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftlern mit exzellenter Vernetzung in der nationalen und internationalen Fach­community und im wirtschaftlichen und gesellschaftlichen Umfeld setzen Sie ein Promotionsvorhaben im Kern des Zentrums um und tragen zur nachhaltigen Profilierung des Forschungszentrums in der Hochschullandschaft bei. Bei Interesse besteht die Möglichkeit der Lehrtätigkeit im Umfang von bis zu 4 SWS sowie der lehrdidaktischen Weiterbildung.
 IHRE AUFGABEN eigenständige Bearbeitung eines Promotionsvorhabens im Themenbereich des Forschungszentrums, insbesondere zur Optimierung gelernter Strategien im Zwilling und zu deren bidirektionaler Kopplung mit realen Systemen – von der kollaborativen Robotik bis zur optimalen Produktionsplanung; Teilnahme am Promotionskolleg der Hochschule und an den Forschungskolloquien des Forschungszentrums
 Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von eigenen und Mitwirkung an gemeinsamen wissenschaftlichen Publikationen
 eigenständige Ausgestaltung und Durchführung von Aufgaben innerhalb des Forschungszentrums, insbesondere im Arbeitspaket „Infrastruktur und Systemintegration“: Zusammenführung bestehender Softwaremodule aus laufenden Forschungsprojekten sowie geeigneter Open-Source-Komponenten zu einer gemeinsamen Plattform, Unterstützung der Forscher*innen bei der Überführung in die Plattform:  Entwicklung von Modellen und Lernverfahren in Python, Integration in die Plattform des Zentrums sowie Validierung an Realdaten
 IHR PROFIL abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Mechatronik, Automatisierungstechnik, Robotik oder einem verwandten Fach
 Interesse an einem Promotionsvorhaben mit einer fachlichen Vertiefung, die an das Forschungszentrum anschlussfähig ist; wünschenswert ist einer der folgenden Schwerpunkte:
 Lernverfahren: Reinforcement Learning, insbesondere modellbasierte Verfahren oder Surrogatmodelle
 Reale Umgebungen: Robotik, Echtzeit- und Produktionssysteme, Produktionssteuerung, ROS 2, Containerisierung oder Edge Computing
 Virtuelle Umgebungen: XR-Entwicklung oder 3D-Rekonstruktion
 eine kurze Skizze eigener thematischer Vorstellungen ist ausdrücklich willkommen
 sichere Programmierkenntnisse, vorzugsweise in Python und/oder C++, sowie Grundkenntnisse in Methoden des Software-Engineering (Schnittstellenentwurf, Versionsverwaltung, Testen)
 Kenntnisse in Modellierung und Simulation hybrider Systeme, z. B. Metamodelle, Zustands- und Automatenmodelle, Mehrkörper­simulationen sowie in maschinellem Lernen
 Bereitschaft, in Laborumgebungen an realen Systemen zu arbeiten und Demonstratoren über Disziplingrenzen hinweg aufzubauen, etwa im XR- und im Robotiklabor
 eigenständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit in einem multidisziplinären Team
 sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
 Organisatorisch ist das Forschungszentrum als Einrichtung der Hochschule an der Fakultät Management, Kultur und Technik angesiedelt. Ihnen steht die dort und an anderen Orten der Hochschule vorhandene Forschungsinfrastruktur zur Verfügung.
 Die Beschäftigung erfolgt in Vollzeit und ist als Qualifizierungsstelle nach § 2 Abs. 1 WissZeitVG in Abhängigkeit von evtl. anzurechnenden Vorzeiten auf 36 Monate befristet. Grundsätzlich sind Vollzeitstellen teilbar, sofern keine dienstlichen Gründe entgegenstehen. Der Arbeitsort ist Lingen mit der Möglichkeit der Vereinbarung zur mobilen Arbeit. Die Vergütung erfolgt nach Entgeltgruppe 13 des TV-L. Die Stelle ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt zu besetzen.
 Die Hochschule Osnabrück behält es sich vor, die Auswahlgespräche in Präsenz oder online durchzuführen.
 WIR setzen uns für Ihre Vereinbarkeit von Beruf, Familie und Privatleben ein (z. B. flexible Arbeits­zeiten, Teilzeit und mobiles Arbeiten)
 unterstützen mit Inhouse-Weiterbildungen und externen Fortbildungen Ihre persönliche Weiter­entwicklung.
 bieten Ihnen Möglich­keiten, die eigene Gesundheit zu fördern (Hochschulsport & Firmen­fitness).

Wie das Engineering der Zukunft aussieht, erforschen wir am Fraunhofer-Institut für Entwurfstechnik Mechatronik IEM in Paderborn – gemeinsam mit starken Partnern und viel Leidenschaft für Technik. Unsere Teams entwickeln Lösungen, die wirklich in die Anwendung kommen: von smarten Produkten über vernetzte Produktionssysteme bis hin zu digitalen Services und moderner Software. Dabei denken wir Innovation vom ersten Konzept bis zur Umsetzung. Und genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.
 Die Abteilung Advanced Systems Engineering verbindet Systems Engineering, modellbasierte Entwicklung und Künstliche Intelligenz, um komplexe technische Systeme durchgängig und effizient zu entwickeln.
 Hier sorgst Du für Veränderung 
 Du entwickelst und evaluierst KI-gestützte Methoden, Prototypen und Demonstratoren für Systems Engineering und Model-Based Systems Engineering – beispielsweise im Requirements Engineering, bei Konsistenz- und Abhängigkeitsanalysen, in der Traceability oder in der Wissensrepräsentation.
 Du arbeitest in Forschungs- und Industrieprojekten entlang des gesamten Entwicklungsprozesses – von der Problemstrukturierung über die methodische Konzeption bis hin zur technischen Umsetzung und Validierung.
 Du integrierst neue KI-Funktionen in bestehende Tool-Landschaften, Datenflüsse und Engineering-Prozesse und bewertest deren Mehrwert im realen Anwendungskontext.
 Du arbeitest interdisziplinär mit Kolleg:innen, Industriepartnern und öffentlichen Auftraggebern zusammen, bereitest Ergebnisse adressatengerecht auf und präsentierst diese überzeugend.
 Du veröffentlichst Deine Ergebnisse in Fachbeiträgen, wirkst an Workshops, Schulungen und Akquiseaktivitäten mit und entwickelst das Themenfeld Advanced Systems Engineering aktiv weiter.
 Hiermit bringst Du Dich ein 
 Sehr gut abgeschlossenes Universitätsstudium in Informatik, Systems Engineering, Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang
 Praxiserfahrung oder gute Kenntnisse in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: KI/ML, Generative AI, NLP, RAG- oder Agentensysteme, Softwareentwicklung, Datenverarbeitung, API-basierte Toolintegration, DevOps, CI/CD, Containerisierung sowie Cloud-Plattformen wie Microsoft Azure oder AWS
 Gute Kenntnisse im Systems Engineering / MBSE, Requirements Engineering, in der Systemarchitektur oder in verwandten Entwicklungsansätzen
 Fähigkeit, Dich schnell in neue Domänen einzuarbeiten, komplexe Problemstellungen strukturiert zu durchdenken und eigenständig in tragfähige Konzepte zu überführen
 Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch sowie Freude daran, technische Inhalte gegenüber Kund:innen, Projektpartnern und wissenschaftlichem Publikum überzeugend zu vertreten
 Was wir für Dich bereithalten 
 Freu Dich auf eine Position, in der Du die Innovationen von morgen vorantreibst.
 Eine ausgeprägte Teamkultur mit flachen Hierarchien ist für uns selbstverständlich. Das bedeutet: hohe Wertschätzung und Vertrauen, eine angenehme und familienfreundliche Arbeitsatmosphäre, Teamevents, gemeinsame Mittagessen und kreative Kolleg*innen.
 Es erwartet Dich ein modern ausgestattetes Arbeitsumfeld mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit einer Homeoffice-Regelung mit Rücksicht auf Deine beruflichen und privaten Herausforderungen.
 Du greifst für Deinen Arbeitsweg auf öffentliche Verkehrsmittel zurück? Dann nutze unser Jobticket! Weitere spannende Vorteile für Mitarbeitende findest Du auf unserer Website.
 Wir unterstützen Dich aktiv bei der Vereinbarung von Arbeits- und Familienleben und sind stolz auf die Auszeichnung »Familienfreundliches Unternehmen« im Kreis Paderborn.
 Deine Karriereentwicklung unterstützen wir mit einer gezielten Laufbahnplanung, einer großen Auswahl an fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterbildungen sowie einer engen Begleitung auf dem Weg zu Deiner Promotion.
 Mit dem Talenta-Förderprogramm bieten wir Frauen in der Forschung die umfassende Möglichkeit, die Karriere individuell und gezielt durch entsprechende Qualifizierungsangebote nach vorne zu bringen.
 Du erhältst eine faire Bezahlung nach dem Tarifvertrag des öffentlichen Dienstes (Bund) sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL). Außerdem bieten wir attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte (Fraunhofer Corporate Benefits) für eine große Auswahl attraktiver Marken.
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. 
 Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Anstellung, Vergütung und Sozialleistungen basieren auf dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD). Zusätzlich kann Fraunhofer leistungs- und erfolgsabhängige variable Vergütungsbestandteile gewähren.

Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.

items.jobDescription:
Tätigkeitsbeschreibung: 
 In order to support “Combat Electronic Warfare Ground Support Solutions”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a 
 Operational EW Specialist - Mission Data & Ground Support System (d/f/m) 
 We are seeking a highly motivated engineer to join our interdisciplinary field of Ground Support Systems. We are an international Team within the Mission Systems center of competence.  We are responsible for developing and maintaining modern ground support systems for the A400M, Eurofighter and Tornado platforms at the Manching site in Germany.
Our products enable preparation, test and evaluation of mission data libraries before being uploaded to the aircraft, especially in the context of electronic warfare, defensive aids and electronic combat.
The job holder will become part of an agile team developing state-of-the-art EW (Electronic Warfare) mission data systems for the aforementioned platforms for international clients.  
 Your location 
Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
To provide expert guidance to systems engineers on how airforce units utilize EW mission data in real-world scenarios.  
 Support the system development team with your operational knowledge throughout the life cycle of the mission support systems projects, which includes system concept definition, system design, requirements validation, system test & qualification in an agile approach 
 Translate complex defence EW operational needs into clear technical requirements for engineering teams. 
 Define, document, and validate end-to-end operational use cases for EW ground support software.  
 Design the concepts, interfaces, and workflows required to seamlessly integrate our ground support systems into the EW Center operational infrastructure 
 Support and participate in customer meetings, technical reviews and workshops to iterate and improve the customer satisfaction with our products. 
 Generate representative EW mission data libraries to support aircraft development phases, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, and flight test.  
 Foster collaboration within our project team and with involved stakeholders - internal and external 
 Actively support the continuous improvements of our products, projects and processes 
 ​
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 A degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field 
 Operational defence EW background: multiple years of active-duty or civilian experience within the National Electronic Warfare Center  
 Mission Data Expertise: proven, hands-on experience in EW Mission Data programming, emitter customization, or the generation of threat libraries 
 Ground Support Systems: deep understanding of the operational lifecycle of EW systems, including mission data preparation, mission data verification/validation, and post-flight analysis 
 Strong team player, independent working method and high quality awareness 
 Strong communication skills 
 Language skills: business fluent in German and English is an advantage 
 #MYCYM 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

**Das ist zukünftig dein Job**
* Entwicklung und Integration von Systemkomponenten im Bereich Maschinenbau oder Elektrotechnik

* Erfahrung mit modellbasierter Entwicklung (MBSE), z B MATLAB/Simulink
