 termios ist ein 2023 gegründetes Joint-Venture von mantro als Company Builder, dem sauerländischen Familienunternehmen Oventrop und der Düsseldorfer LEG Immobilien SE. Als Technologieunternehmen entwickeln wir grüne Lösungen rund um Heizen, Nachhaltigkeit und ESG für Wohnimmobilien.
 Warum wir diese Stelle besetzen 
 Unser Thermostat termios Pro übernimmt den hydraulischen Abgleich automatisch, für jeden einzelnen Heizkörper, und ist in tausenden Wohnungen verbaut. Daraus entsteht ein Messdatenbestand zum realen Heizbetrieb im Gebäudebestand, wie ihn kaum ein einzelnes Forschungsprojekt aufbauen kann.
 Wie viel Energie spart der automatische Abgleich wirklich, unter welchen Bedingungen, und wie weist man das sauber nach? Diese und ähnliche Fragestellungen wollen wir gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungsinstituten, Wohnungsunternehmen und Fördergebern beantworten.
 Du startest dabei nicht bei null: Wir haben bereits zwei vom BMWE geförderte Forschungsprojekte und sind in weiteren Forschungsfeldern aktiv. Für dieses wachsende Portfolio suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt jemanden, der Forschung nicht nur organisiert, sondern selbst betreibt.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Studiendesign und Feldversuche: Du übersetzt offene Fragen in prüfbare Hypothesen und ein belastbares Studiendesign mit Vergleichsgruppen, Baseline, Witterungsbereinigung und Messkonzept. Messkampagnen in realen Liegenschaften setzt du gemeinsam mit Field Service und Anlagentechnik um.
 Datenanalyse: Du wertest Zeitreihen aus dem Gerätebestand und aus Messkampagnen selbst aus, quantifizierst Effekte und Unsicherheiten und trennst sauber zwischen Korrelation und Wirkung.
 Ergebnisse: Du bereitest Erkenntnisse für Abschlussberichte, Fachpublikationen, Konferenzen und Kunden auf und sorgst dafür, dass sie in unsere Algorithmen und Produktentwicklung zurückfließen.
 Projektleitung: Du steuerst mehrere parallel laufende Forschungs- und Pilotprojekte, von Arbeitspaketen und Meilensteinen über Budgets und Berichtspflichten bis zu Kooperationsverträgen, Datenschutz und Förderrichtlinien.
 Förderung und Akquise: Du findest passende Förderprogramme auf Landes-, Bundes- und EU-Ebene, entwickelst Projektideen mit Partnern und schreibst Skizzen und Anträge.
 Das bringst du mit
 Studium: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem ingenieur-, natur- oder datenwissenschaftlichen Fach, z. B. Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Versorgungstechnik, Bauphysik, Physik, Mathematik oder Informatik.
 Forschungserfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre in der angewandten Forschung gearbeitet, etwa an einem Fraunhofer-Institut, einer anderen Forschungseinrichtung, einer Hochschule oder in einer F&E-Abteilung, idealerweise im Umfeld Gebäude, Energie oder TGA.
 Methodik und Daten: Du hast Studien oder Messkampagnen selbst konzipiert und ausgewertet, wendest statistische Verfahren wie Regression, Zeitreihenanalyse und Hypothesentests sicher an und arbeitest dabei mit Python oder R sowie SQL.
 Projektleitung: Du hast Projekte mit mehreren Partnern geleitet oder koordiniert und bringst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen.
 Kommunikation: Du schreibst klar und belastbar, vom Förderantrag bis zur Veröffentlichung. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch auf Arbeitsniveau.
 Das ist ein Plus
 Niemand bringt alles mit. Vieles davon lernst du bei uns.
 Förderprojekte: Du hast schon Anträge geschrieben oder öffentlich geförderte Projekte abgewickelt.
 Heizungstechnik: Du kennst dich mit Heizungshydraulik, hydraulischem Abgleich und Wärmeerzeugern wie Fernwärme oder Wärmepumpe aus.
 Einsparnachweise: Du kennst Verfahren zur Messung und Verifikation von Einsparungen, z. B. IPMVP.
 Modelle: Du hast Erfahrung mit Gebäudesimulation (z. B. Modelica, TRNSYS) oder Machine Learning.
 Promotion oder eigene Publikationen 
 Gute Gründe, um bei uns durchzustarten
 Forschung, die ankommt: Wenn du eine Hypothese an einem realen Gebäude prüfen willst, organisieren wir das. Was du herausfindest, landet im Produkt, und Veröffentlichungen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.
 Alles unter einem Dach: Hardware, Firmware, Funk, Cloud und Daten. Wer das gebaut hat, wonach du fragst, sitzt im selben Team.
 Gestaltungsfreiraum ab dem ersten Tag, in einem agilen Team mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
 Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid in Düsseldorf oder München, mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
 Konditionen: Unbefristete Festanstellung, wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung, 30 Tage Urlaub, Urban Sports und Corporate Benefits sowie regelmäßige Teamevents.
 Klingt nach dir?
 Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, gern mit Publikationsliste oder Links zu deinen Projekten. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schreib uns lieber ein paar Sätze dazu, welche Forschungsfrage dich bei uns besonders reizt.

Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.
 We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.
 Are you ready to join us?
 Your team 
This job is with Statista R, a vertical business unit of Statista.
 Statista R is a world leader in the creation of company, brand, and product rankings and top lists, based on comprehensive market research and data analysis: Statista R recognizes the best.
 With a team of over 100 expert analysts and in cooperation with more than 40 high profile media brands across all continents like Forbes, TIME Magazine and Newsweek, Statista R creates transparency for consumers and business decision makers and helps companies build trust and recognition across a plethora of industries and product categories. A team of over 50 licensing specialists based in New York, Hamburg, Tokyo, and Singapore offers the awarded companies meaningful and eye-catching opportunities to communicate their success via logos and other award related products. Visit rankings.statista.com for further information about Statista R and our rankings.
 Your Role 
 Design, build and maintain web applications for working with data as a core part of your role, mainly using Python frameworks such as Django and Streamlit
 Work closely with our senior Data Engineer and other experienced data professionals who build our analytics products and pipelines, learn hands-on about our AWS cloud environment and ETL processes, and help build reliable data pipelines and PostgreSQL queries
 Prepare, transform and validate data so our applications and analyses rest on a solid foundation
 Create visualizations and insight reports that make findings clear and actionable, both to make our analyst team's processes more efficient and to produce strong client-facing materials
 Work with teammates to turn analytical questions into usable features and workflows, and develop repeatable ways to build expertise and value for our stakeholders
 Support projects based on large-scale, survey-based market research data, and help develop methods that complement our existing ranking products
 Your Profile 
 Solid hands-on skills in Python, gained through professional work, internships, research, or your own projects. Experience coding in R is advantageous
 Experience building web applications with Django and/or Streamlit is a strong plus. Knowledge of PostgreSQL or another SQL database, and basic HTML, CSS or JavaScript, is also a plus
 A basic understanding of cloud environments such as AWS and of ETL concepts, and the motivation to grow these skills alongside experienced colleagues
 Hands-on experience working with data, including querying, cleaning, analyzing, visualizing and checking data quality
 Clean coding habits that make teamwork easy, such as readable code and basic Git workflows
 Enjoyment in building tools other people use, a collaborative way of working, and the curiosity to dig into unfamiliar problems
 What we offer

 International team and social events

 Mental health support with OpenUp

 Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.
 We’re a profitable, fast-growing scale-up with $43M raised and over $100M in annual revenue. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.

 Continuously improve existing algorithms and identify opportunities for new ones

 Private medical and dental insurance
 Life and critical illness cover
 Latest-generation MacBook Pro and 4k display
 Monthly credit towards Wheely journeys
 Cycle to Work scheme
 Professional development stipend

Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
 Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
 This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
 About the Role 
 This role focuses on building performant, maintainable systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful features that meet business and customer needs.  Architect scalable, modular services while ensuring data integrity, security, and availability across distributed environments

 Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin (backend), with experience in relational databases and API development
 Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts and performance optimization techniques
 Strong grasp of software design principles (SOLID, separation of concerns, DRY) and design patterns, with the ability to write maintainable, testable code
 Experience with automated testing and CI/CD, and the ability to define and document technical specifications, balancing feature development with technical debt

About the Role at RobCo 
 RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. 
   In this key role, you are the driving force behind extending our modular robotics solutions with new peripheral components, from grippers and sensors to tools and beyond. Whenever a customer application calls for a new component, you take it from first prototype to a validated, reusable standard, fully integrated with our modular robots and ready for deployment. By turning each new component into a proven building block, supported by clear documentation and repeatable processes, you enable our teams to get solutions live faster and deliver end-to-end robotics that just works. In doing so, you help our platform adapt to each customer's use case, not the other way around, and help us simplify to scale.
 Your Responsibilities 
 Component Prototyping & Development: Prototype and evaluate new peripheral components such as grippers, sensors, and other mechatronic assemblies, identifying what does and doesn't work for our purpose.
 Mechatronic Integration: Assemble, wire, and configure new components and integrate them mechanically, electrically, and on the software side into our modular robotic systems.
 Iterative Development: Take on technical tasks that don't have a fixed, known solution path, and use an iterative development approach to find the best way to make a new component work reliably.
 Validation: Test and verify new components thoroughly before they are released for use in customer projects.
 Peripheral Standardization: Turn custom, one-off setups into reliable, repeatable standards that work across different customer applications.
 Documentation & Handover: Create the documentation, configuration guides, and processes that enable our deployment teams to use new components independently during the installation of robotic solutions.
 Requirements Translation: Learn to abstract complex requirements from various sources and translate them into actionable work packages, either to be solved within our department or clearly communicated to Product Management.
 Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, our Solution Development team, and customers to develop components that help our organization scale.
 We are looking for someone who has: 
 Completed a degree in Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable technical field.
 Initial practical experience (via previous projects or early career steps) in building, prototyping, or integrating mechatronic or robotic systems and components.
 An iterative approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy the challenge of trial-and-error, and are eager to find paths forward when there is no manual.
 A holistic engineering approach: you look beyond your immediate tasks to understand how the components you develop fit into the larger system and how others will use them.
 A growth mindset: you are driven by the principle of automation (not doing things twice manually) and are excited to expand your skills into requirements gathering and cross-department collaboration.
 Solid foundational knowledge of electrical circuits, sensor integration, wiring diagrams, and mechanical components.
 A structured and pragmatic working style, a strong ownership mindset, and the ability to document your work so that others can rely on it.
 Very good English skills (German is a plus).
 Why join RobCo? 
 Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.
 Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.
 As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.
 Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.
 Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.
 Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.
 Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.
 About RobCo 
 Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.
 We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.
 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. 
 At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps.  Transforming 50M+ daily events into real-time actionable dashboard insights

We build the campaign management APIs, analytics engines, and high-throughput tools that allow advertisers and publishers to configure, monitor, and optimize their activity on our platform.

You design and execute structured and exploratory test cases, validate complex user journeys across frontend and backend, and perform regression testing before releases. Du findest KI spannend, aber noch spannender, was Unternehmen damit im Alltag wirklich anfangen können? Du redest gern mit Menschen, erkennst schnell, wo in einem Betrieb Zeit liegen bleibt, und willst einen Kunden vom ersten Anruf bis zur Unterschrift selbst begleiten? Dann passt du zu uns.
 Ob Berufseinsteiger oder erfahrener Vertriebler: Wichtiger als die Zahl deiner Berufsjahre ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, zuhörst und ehrlich berätst. Du musst kein Entwickler sein. Wie unsere Plattform funktioniert, lernst du bei uns, mit den Leuten, die sie gebaut haben.
 Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten. Neben klassischer IT-Infrastruktur haben wir Nexus entwickelt: eine KI-Plattform, die komplett auf lokaler Hardware beim Kunden läuft. Nexus ersetzt kein ERP und keine andere Software, sondern dockt an die vorhandenen Systeme an. Betriebe automatisieren damit ihre eigenen Abläufe, von der Belegerfassung aus E-Mails über die Angebotserstellung bis zur Wissensdatenbank.
 Aufgaben
 Du erschließt dein eigenes Kundengebiet für Nexus und bist dafür verantwortlich.
 Du betreust deine Kunden vollständig selbst, von der Kaltakquise bis zur finalen Unterschrift: Es gibt keine Übergabe an einen anderen Vertriebler
 Du baust den Vertrieb für unsere KI-Plattform mit auf
 Du planst selbst, welche Unternehmen du in deinem Gebiet ansprichst, und gehst aktiv auf sie zu, per Telefon, über LinkedIn, auf Veranstaltungen und über dein Netzwerk
 Du führst Erstgespräche und findest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden heraus, welche Abläufe sich für KI eignen und welche nicht
 Du zeigst Nexus in Demos, online und vor Ort, und erklärst es so, dass auch Nicht-Techniker den Nutzen verstehen
 Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Technikern die passende Lösung und erstellst das Angebot
 Du fasst nach, verhandelst und holst die Unterschrift
 Du bleibst auch nach dem Start der Ansprechpartner deiner Kunden, erkennst, wo Nexus ihnen noch Arbeit abnehmen kann, und baust dein Gebiet Schritt für Schritt aus
 Du pflegst deine Kontakte und Gespräche so, dass jeder im Team den Stand nachvollziehen kann
 Du bringst zurück ins Team, was Kunden fragen und brauchen, und redest bei der Weiterentwicklung von Nexus mit
 Nexus ist bei Kunden bereits im Einsatz, der Vertrieb dafür steht aber noch am Anfang. Du hast entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Und du stehst nicht allein da: Bei technischen Fragen ist immer ein Kollege da, der mit in den Termin kommt oder mit dir draufschaut.
 Qualifikation
 Das bringst du mit:
 Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung, ein Studium oder vergleichbare Praxis, Quereinsteiger sind willkommen
 Du nutzt KI-Tools selbst und hast Lust, dich tief in das Thema einzuarbeiten
 Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und telefonierst gern, auch mit Leuten, die dich noch nicht kennen
 Du hörst zu, fragst nach und verstehst schnell, wie ein Betrieb arbeitet
 Du erklärst Neues so, dass es beim Gegenüber ankommt, ohne Buzzwords
 Du bleibst dran, auch wenn es beim ersten und zweiten Anruf noch kein Ja gibt
 Du führst Gespräche zu einem Ergebnis und scheust dich nicht, nach dem Auftrag zu fragen
 Du sagst offen, was du denkst, auch gegenüber Kunden, wenn KI für ein Problem nicht die richtige Lösung ist

 Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als ein perfekter Lebenslauf. Wichtig ist, dass du ehrlich berätst und Lust hast, besser zu werden.
 Benefits
 Ein Produkt, das du zeigen kannst. Nexus läuft bereits bei Kunden. Du verkaufst keine Folien, sondern etwas, das du live vorführen kannst.
 Möglichkeit auf einen eigenen Firmenwagen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, einen eigenen Firmenwagen zu bekommen. So bist du für Kundentermine flexibel unterwegs und musst dir um dein eigenes Auto keine Gedanken machen.
 Nah an der Entwicklung. Die Leute, die Nexus gebaut haben, sitzen im selben Büro. Was du vom Kunden mitbringst, fließt direkt ins Produkt ein.
 Moderne Tooling-Kultur. KI-gestütztes Arbeiten für Recherche, Angebote und Vorbereitung statt Zettelwirtschaft.
 Wellpass oder Streaming-Abo. Sport in tausenden Studios deutschlandweit oder Spotify bzw. Netflix auf uns. Such dir aus, was zu dir passt.

Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.
Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.
 About The Role
 We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer in Bengaluru to design, build and run production services end to end. You'll take a problem from a loose description to a shipped, reliable system — and you'll be trusted to do it without step-by-step direction.
Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with your Engineering Manager, Product, and Customer Support, and help raise the technical bar of the team around you.
What you'll own in your first year
 Own: Own your services end to end with speed, quality, depth and long-term vision — design, build, release, monitor, fix.
 Hard problems. Take ambiguous problems, break them down, and drive them to a shipped solution with little hand-holding.
 Design. Write and defend design docs for your area, and make the tradeoffs explicit.
 Quality. Treat testing, observability and on-call as part of the work, so customers don't find our bugs.
 Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and use support issues and usage data to decide what to fix next.
 Raising the bar. Review code thoughtfully, mentor newer engineers, and help interview candidates.
 What you must bring
These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.
 Experience: 3–6 years building production software. More is welcome if the role and level are the right fit for you. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
 You've shipped systems that run in production. Not just features handed off — services you built, released and supported when they broke.
 You are exceptional at problem solving. You take ambiguous, system-level problems with more than one valid answer, reason from first principles, weigh the tradeoffs, and land on a solution that's simple and correct.
 You work with minimal handholding. You've taken loosely defined work from start to finish without needing someone to break it down for you.
 Passion for making System NFRs: You never lose sight of System NFRs to create highly available and extensible systems which are scalable and low on maintenance.
 We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.
Technical background
You've built and run production systems with a modern stack, such as:
 Cloud: AWS — you've designed, deployed and operated services on it, not just consumed them.
 Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
 Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
 Databases, in depth: data modeling, query and index optimization, and scaling (replication, partitioning, caching). You can walk us through a schema you designed and a slow query or bottleneck you fixed, with the before and after.
 Fundamentals: API design, concurrency, caching, and how distributed systems fail.
 Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.
What sets great candidates apart
 Impact you can explain. You can name a result, the baseline it moved from, and what you did to move it.
 One hard problem, told in detail. A scale, performance or debugging story where you understood the internals, not just the API.
 Ownership over time. A system you've owned across versions and kept improving, not one you built and left.
 Framework mindset: You spot repeated custom implementations and turn them into reusable frameworks or libraries others build on.
 Product sense. You've pushed back on a requirement, simplified scope, or suggested a better solution for the user.
 Lifting others. Code reviews, docs or mentoring that made the people around you faster.
 What we look for in everyone we hire
Whatever the role, we hire for six things.
 Customer obsession. You know who uses what you build and what changed for them. You treat support issues and on-call as signal, not chores.
 Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written. You'll choose the boring solution if it ships sooner.
 Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, flag problems early, and say what didn't work.
 Independence. You don't wait to be told what to do next. You find the problem worth solving and get it done with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.
 Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project you kept alive, a technology you went deep on, things you taught others.
 Depth. At least one system or domain you could talk about for an hour, down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Years in a role aren't depth; complexity handled is.
 Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The Role 
 We're looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic core of our product. You'll work closely with our CTO and own LLM-based features and agentic workflows end to end, from the agent framework through to the tooling that connects it to a customer's ERP. You’ll ship the cutting edge models and paradigms to Fortune 500 procurement teams.
 Procurement is a demanding domain for agents: long-running workflows over messy data, where a wrong answer costs a customer real money. You'll decide how multi-agent collaboration works here, and how we benchmark it for performance, safety and behaviour.
 We're building next-generation agentic systems that can manage entire procurement workflows, with a mission to make global manufacturing supply chains more resilient to an ever-changing world. That's a $3tn market opportunity.
 We're backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, and you'll be joining a team bringing together experience from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey.
 What You’ll Do 
 Own development and deployment of LLM-based features and agentic workflows end-to-end
 Develop new agentic frameworks to handle multi-agent collaboration.
 Benchmark LLMs across performance, safety and behavioural monitoring.
 Operationalise AI features by building tools to connect them to customer systems
 Collaborate with customers and internal teams to understand customer problems and design optimal solutions
 You Might Be a Great Fit if You 
 Have engineering experience at tech and product-driven companies, so you know what great code looks like
 Have experience shipping LLM-based solutions to production
 Have a deep understanding of the core technology behind language models, as well as computer science fundamentals
 Have built features end-to-end in Python
 Enjoy communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Compensation and Benefits 
 At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:
 Competitive Equity : play a real part in Magentic’s upside
 A salary of £90,000 - £110,000 per annum 
 Enhanced parental leave 
 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown
 In-office lunches provided 
 Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes 
 Hybrid London HQ (3 days per week, with flex if you have appointments etc)
 Annual team retreat —a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build
 Our Interview Process 
 We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.
 Initial call (30 mins) : this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.
 Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A.
 In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team.
 Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement 
 At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers.

   Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible.

 At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.

What do we do? 
 Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. 
 We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 Build the data, decisioning and automated systems that allow Paddle to take more good risk while reducing fraud losses, unnecessary customer friction and manual work.

Im heutigen, dynamischen Umfeld technologischen Wandels sind intelligente IT-, Software- und Systemlösungen von zentraler Bedeutung – in komplexen, sicherheitskritischen und regulierten Technologiefeldern wie Automotive, Defence und der Luft- und Raumfahrt.
Wir vereinen fundierte Expertise in Avionik, Systemintegration, Verifikation und Qualifikation sowie im Test komplexer sicherheitskritischer Systeme. So entstehen zuverlässige, zertifizierungsfähige Lösungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauberprogramme, bei denen technische Präzision, strukturierte Prozesse und höchste Qualitätsstandards im Mittelpunkt stehen.

Dabei erstellst und bewertest du Finite-Elemente-Modelle , führst dynamische Analysen durch und unterstützt die Vorbereitung und Auswertung von Umwelt- und Vibrationstestkampagnen .

 Vorbereitung und Aufbereitung von Eingabedaten für Umwelt- und Testkampagnen, insbesondere im Bereich Vibration und Akustik
 Unterstützung bei der Korrelation und Bewertung von Analyseergebnissen anhand von Testdaten
 Zusammenarbeit mit multidisziplinären und internationalen Engineering-Teams

 Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Maschinenbau oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation

 Erfahrung im Aerospace-Umfeld ist von Vorteil

 Analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Fragestellungen selbstständig zu bearbeiten
 Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in internationalen und multidisziplinären Teams
 Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
 Verhandlungssichere Englisch- sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse

items.jobTitle: Early Careers - Aerospace and Aeronautical Engineering
items.jobDescription:
Who we are:
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The Bring Something Amazing Initiative: 
 Helsing’s mission is to protect our democracies. Delivering sovereign AI and mission-critical software capability requires exceptional engineering talent at every level. Following our recent funding and the success of early-career engineers across our teams—including talent from our Formula Student partnerships—we are opening multiple roles across our London and Munich Physical Products Engineering teams. Traditional recruitment often places artificial barriers in front of early-career builders. Resumes rarely tell the full story of your technical depth, intuition, or drive. To solve this, we are piloting a direct, craft-first hiring path: Bring Something Awesome to Apply (BSA2A).
(This route is designed specifically for early-career engineers. It is entirely optional, you may still apply via our standard job listings if you prefer.)
 Please note that candidates will be considered for the office nearest to them but may also be required to relocate.
 The Process:
 At the core of our technical interview philosophy is Bring Something Awesome (BSA). A dedicated session where candidates present an ambitious technical project they have designed, built, or contributed to.
With BSA2A, we are bringing this step to the very front of the application. Instead of an initial CV and recruiter screen, you apply by submitting a short (maximum 10-minute) prerecorded video walkthrough of something technically compelling you have built. We look for:
 Engineering depth & craft: Technically challenging hardware designs. 
 First-principles problem solving: The ability to deconstruct complex technical challenges autonomously. 
 Clear technical communication: The ability to explain the how and why behind your trade-offs succinctly. 
 Candidates selected through BSA2A move into an accelerated, streamlined technical assessment:
 Expression of Interest: Complete the short form below to confirm your eligibility. Our team will review submissions. 
 Video Submission: Eligible candidates receive a private link with detailed guidance to upload their 10-minute BSA walkthrough. Every video is evaluated directly by a Helsing engineer, not an algorithm or automated keyword filter. 
 Technical Interviews (2 × 60 mins): 
 Round 1: BSA Deep Dive. An interactive, technical exploration of your project and system trade-offs.
Round 2: Requirements and Design Interview. Practical, real-world scenario and problem-solving task.
Final Interview (30 mins): A conversation with engineering leadership focused on mission alignment, collaboration, and how you work.
 Note: The initial form below is simply an expression of interest. You do not need your video recorded to submit this form. If your profile is eligible, we will send you dedicated instructions and a submission window.
 Why apply via this route?
 Evaluated on proof of work, not pedigree: Your designs, choices, and technical curiosity take centre stage—not university ranking, buzzwords, or CV formatting. 
 Play to your strengths: Your application is assessed directly by Helsing engineers on what you can actually build. Putting your real-world work front and centre gives you the highest signal—and the highest probability of success. 
 Accelerated timeline: A focused, high-signal path that bypasses standard preliminary screens and reduces the overall interview cycle by two full stages.
 The Role:
 At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so must be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve.
 The Day-to-Day:
 Find more information on the day-to-day:
 Mechanical Designer, Prototyping Engineer, Deployed Hardware Engineer GNC Engineer 
 Please note, you need to apply via this page to be considered for the BSA2A process.
 You Should Apply If You: 
 Please note that we do not expect candidates to have experience with all of the points below, however we have outlined areas of relevant experiences
 Have a solid background in airframe design, structural anaylsis or propulsion engineering. 
 Are passionate about keeping up to date with current research and enjoy reimplementing / extending concepts on state-of-the-art navigation and guidance algorithms. 
 Have built and validated flight dynamics models from first principles, and tested them against real flight or experimental data 
 Have proven experience taking concepts to field testing. 
 Have planned and executed test campaigns and can close the loop between test data and simulation through systematic model correlation 
 Can deliver into complex programmes across major aeronautical subdomains, including but not limited to: system architecture, airframe configuration, aerodynamics, structural analysis, materials evaluation, avionics integration, flight mechanics and rapid prototyping. 
 Possess solid software engineering skills, writing clean and well-structured code in common languages like python, C++, Matlab or rust. 
 Are practically minded, able to derive solutions to new problems from first principles. 
 Make progress where there is uncertainty, creating clarity whilst driving forwards the solution. 
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with drone, UAV, Fixed wing or rocket design, including familiarity with the specific load cases and certification considerations of unmanned systems. 
 Proficiency in CAD software such as AutoCAD, SOLIDWORKS, CATIA or Siemens NX. 
 Hands-on experience developing rocket systems. 
 Have worked with deployed software on embedded systems.
 Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What we offer
 Competitive salary and VSOP options 
 Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation 
 Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance 
 Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health) 
 Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances 
 Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers 
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work 
 A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one 
 Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

Automation Engineer (Industrial Automation & Controls)
 We are seeking an experienced Automation Engineer to design and implement the control software and automation architecture for a highly automated manufacturing environment. This role will be responsible for developing PLC and HMI logic, defining interfaces between production equipment and business systems, and ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation of automated processes.
 This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing technology-driven manufacturing business that is investing heavily in automation, production scalability, and operational excellence. The environment offers significant autonomy, ownership, and the opportunity to shape systems and processes from the ground up.
 Required Experience 
 Significant experience in industrial automation, PLC programming, and controls architecture within a manufacturing or process-driven environment.
 Strong hands-on experience with a major PLC platform, ideally Beckhoff.
 Solid knowledge of IEC 61131-3 programming and structured software development methodologies.
 Experience integrating PLC systems with MES, ERP, databases, or other enterprise systems using OPC UA or similar communication protocols.
 Desirable Experience 
 Python or similar programming languages for tooling, test automation, and data analysis.
 Industrial robot integration experience (ABB, Fanuc, KUKA, Beckhoff Motion, or similar).
 Batch process control and recipe management systems.
 SCADA and HMI development experience (e.g., WinCC, Ignition, TwinCAT HMI).
 Production traceability systems, barcode/RFID technologies, or serialisation solutions.
 Knowledge of regulated or safety-critical manufacturing environments.
 Commissioning experience in startup, greenfield, or rapidly expanding production facilities.
 Compensation & Benefits
 Highly competitive salary and performance-based incentive package.
 Long-term equity participation opportunity.
 Relocation support available for suitable candidates.
 Comprehensive benefits package.
 Opportunity to work on cutting-edge manufacturing technologies within a high-growth engineering organisation.
 This role is suited to individuals who are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. The position offers substantial autonomy and the opportunity to make a significant impact on the development and scalability of advanced manufacturing operations.

About Graphcore 
 At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence. 
 Job Summary
 As a research engineer at Graphcore, you will contribute to the advancement of AI research, investigating new ideas that push the limits on important AI/ML problems. Specialised hardware has been the key driver of the progress of AI over the last decade, and we believe that hardware-aware AI algorithms and AI-aware hardware developments will continue to be critical to advancing this exciting field. We are therefore looking for individuals who combine strong machine learning experience with practical engineering skills to deliver impactful AI research. We are seeking AI researchers with strong software engineering experience, particularly in lower-level programming and performance optimisation for hardware efficiency. Our research spans a broad range of topics, including efficient training and inference, world models, life sciences, reinforcement learning, and beyond. You will work closely with researchers to generate ideas and translate them into scalable implementations, contributing to publications and projects that help to steer the future of AI hardware.
 The Team
 Graphcore Research participates in both fundamental and applied research, to characterise the computational requirements of machine intelligence and to demonstrate how hardware can drive the next generation of innovative AI models. We publish at leading AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) as well as specialist workshops, and collaborate with other research teams and organisations across the world.
 We pride ourselves on being a supportive and collaborative team, where we organise around our individual research interests to solve problems together in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications, including for sequence- and graph-based data. We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.
 Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our papers or an article on our blog . If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!
 Responsibilities and Duties
 Generate AI/ML ideas, design experiments, implement them & evaluate results.
 Prepare, submit & present your work to AI conferences and workshops.
 Provide technical insight to internal teams by designing experiments and delivering clear, actionable reports.
 Collaborate with researchers, silicon and software engineers at Graphcore to help define, build and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.
 About you:
 Essential:
  Master’s, PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline (e.g., Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry).
 Python programming in a modern deep learning framework, e.g. PyTorch or JAX.
 Familiar with deep learning fundamentals: models, optimisation, evaluation and scaling.
 Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.
 Lower-level programming for hardware efficiency, e.g. C++/CUDA/Triton.
 Practical familiarity with hardware capabilities for deep learning – threads, caches, vector & matrix engines, data dependencies, bus widths and throttling.
 Practical familiarity with software stacks for deep learning – compilation, kernel fusion, XLA/ATen ops, streams, and asynchronous execution
 Desirable:
 Mathematics skills to support the above: calculus, probability theory and linear algebra.
 Experience submitting papers to international scientific conferences or workshops.
 Benefits 
 In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension (matched up to 5%), life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We offer a range of healthy food and snacks at our central Bristol office and have our own barista bar! We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.
 Applicants for this position must hold the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately at this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support for visa applications

items.jobDescription:
Alternate Job Titles
 EDA Licensing and Installation Support Engineer
 Technical Application Engineer, Licensing Infrastructure
 Staff Applications Engineer, EDA Tools Support
 Licensing and Deployment Applications Engineer
 CAD/EDA Support Engineer, Staff Level
 We Are
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
 You Are
 You have spent years keeping the infrastructure running that everyone else depends on to do their jobs, and you know that when a license server goes down at 3 a.m. in Tokyo, someone's tapeout schedule just became your problem. You are the person who can look at a FlexNet debug log, spot the misconfigured options file or the firewall rule that is blocking port 27000, and have it fixed before the customer finishes explaining what went wrong.
 You do not just troubleshoot, you think in systems. You understand how a three-server redundant licensing setup should behave, why a migration from on-prem to cloud changes the MAC address binding, and what happens when someone upgrades RHEL without testing the environment variables first. You have been in enough customer environments to know that 'it worked in dev' means nothing until it works in production.
 You are comfortable talking to a senior CAD engineer about daemon logs and then turning around to explain to a procurement lead why their license count does not match their headcount. You move fast, you document what you learn, and you do not wait for perfect information to start solving the problem. At Synopsys, you will work with global customers who depend on you to keep their design environments operational, and the problems you solve will directly enable the next generation of chips.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Support and troubleshoot Synopsys Common Licensing (SCL) and FlexNet licensing environments for global enterprise customers across Americas, EMEA, Japan, and APAC
 Perform root-cause analysis on complex licensing, installation, deployment, migration, and failover issues, working directly with customer IT, CAD, and engineering teams
 Design, validate, and implement licensing architectures for large-scale enterprise deployments, including three-server redundancy setups and cross-platform configurations
 Lead on-site and remote installation, upgrade, and migration activities for customers deploying or expanding Synopsys EDA toolsets
 Mentor applications engineers and provide technical leadership across support and customer success organizations
 Collaborate with Engineering, R&D, Sales, and Customer Success teams to escalate critical issues, influence product roadmaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable improvements
 Build and maintain technical articles, runbooks, and self-service documentation in the Synopsys Knowledge Base to scale support and reduce resolution time
 The Impact You Will Have
 Keep customer design environments operational during critical tapeout windows, directly enabling revenue and preventing schedule slips
 Reduce escalation time and resolution cycles for high-priority licensing and deployment issues across Synopsys's largest accounts
 Influence product development by surfacing real-world deployment challenges and customer needs to R&D and product teams
 Scale support effectiveness by creating reusable documentation, automation scripts, and training content that empower frontline engineers and customers
 Strengthen customer relationships by acting as a trusted technical advisor who understands both their infrastructure and their business pressures
 Drive adoption and expansion of Synopsys technologies by ensuring smooth deployments, migrations, and upgrades across diverse customer environments
 Mentor and elevate the technical capabilities of the broader applications engineering team through knowledge sharing and hands-on collaboration
 What You'll Need
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or related field with 6+ years of experience, or Master's degree with 4+ years in EDA tool support, CAD/CAE engineering, IT operations, or software application support
 Strong proficiency in Linux/Unix system administration (RHEL, CentOS, SLES), including process management, file permissions, environment variables, and shell scripting
 Hands-on expertise with FlexNet/FLEXlm licensing architecture, including debug logs, options files, daemon configuration, and redundant server setups
 Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking, ports, firewalls, DNS, host IDs, and MAC addresses as they relate to client-server licensing communication
 Working knowledge of scripting languages such as Bash, Python, Perl, or PowerShell for log parsing, automation, and troubleshooting
 Experience with Windows Server administration for cross-platform EDA tool environments is a plus
 Familiarity with EDA product flows, Synopsys toolsets, or Agentic AI usage is a plus
 Who You Are
 You can walk a customer through a three-server licensing failover scenario and then write a two-paragraph summary for their VP of Engineering without losing the technical thread
 You stay calm under pressure, especially when a licensing issue is blocking a customer's critical milestone and multiple time zones are waiting for your answer
 You think like a detective when diagnosing issues, you do not stop at the symptom, you trace it back to the root cause even if it means digging through daemon logs and network packet captures
 You are detail-oriented and organized enough to manage multiple high-priority escalations across global accounts without dropping threads or missing follow-ups
 You are curious and self-motivated, you do not wait to be told what to learn, you dig into new licensing models, deployment architectures, and automation opportunities on your own
 You value collaboration and knowledge sharing, you document what you learn, mentor others, and contribute to the collective expertise of the team
 The Team You'll Be Part Of
 You will be part of Synopsys's Technical Sales and Applications Engineering organization, which serves as the critical bridge between customers, sales teams, R&D, and product groups. This team is responsible for enabling customers to successfully adopt, deploy, and expand their use of Synopsys EDA technologies while driving revenue growth and operational excellence. You will work closely with global support engineers, customer success teams, and product engineering across multiple regions, and you will have direct visibility into how the infrastructure you support powers the design workflows behind self-driving cars, AI accelerators, 5G chipsets, and the next wave of smart everything.
 Rewards and Benefits
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Join Hitachi Energy's Controlling Capability Centre as an Enterprise Software Controlling Analyst , where you will play a pivotal role in driving financial insight, business performance, and strategic decision-making for our Software business. This position offers an exciting opportunity to combine financial expertise, business partnering, and digital transformation in a truly global environment.
As part of a dynamic and collaborative finance team, you will support business growth by delivering high-quality financial analysis, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and controlling activities. You will work closely with Business Unit Controllers, Project Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to provide meaningful insights into financial performance and drive informed business decisions.
The role provides exposure to complex financial processes across global markets, enabling you to influence operational performance while ensuring strong governance and compliance standards. You will analyze revenue streams, profitability drivers, cash flow trends, and key business metrics to identify risks, opportunities, and improvement areas. Your recommendations will help leadership teams optimize performance and achieve strategic objectives.
In addition to core controlling responsibilities, you will contribute to Hitachi Energy's ongoing digital transformation initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA programs within the Software business landscape. You will have the opportunity to support process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement projects that shape the future of finance operations.
This role is ideal for a finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys translating data into actionable business insights, and is passionate about improving processes through technology and innovation. At Hitachi Energy, you will collaborate with talented professionals worldwide, expand your expertise, and contribute to building a sustainable energy future while advancing your own career growth.

 Analyze Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and key financial metrics to provide actionable business insights.
 Partner with Business Unit Controllers, Operational Unit Controllers, and Project Managers to monitor and improve business performance.
 Prepare management presentations, financial reports, and executive-level analyses to support strategic decision-making.

 Monitor business risks, revenue trends, profitability drivers, and cash flow performance to support sustainable growth.
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance process efficiency, reporting quality, and business outcomes.
 Your Background
 CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, or MBA (Finance) qualification.
 2-5 years of experience in Financial Controlling, FP&A, Management Accounting, or related finance functions.
 Strong hands-on experience working with SAP S/4HANA in a finance or controlling environment.
 Solid understanding of SAP CO integration with FI, MM, SD, PP, and PS modules.
 Experience in Project Controlling, Software Controlling, or complex business-finance partnering environments is preferred.
 Knowledge of Salesforce (SFDC) and its financial business processes is considered an advantage.
 Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a global environment.
 Fluent written and spoken English with the ability to communicate financial insights to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
 More About Us
At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure. Our people are at the heart of this mission, collaborating across geographies and functions to deliver innovative solutions that create lasting value for customers and communities.
We offer a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages continuous learning, career development, and innovation. You will gain exposure to global finance transformation initiatives, leading technologies, and challenging business scenarios while working alongside industry experts.
Hitachi Energy is committed to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion where every individual can contribute, grow, and succeed. Join us and be part of a team shaping the future of energy and digital transformation.

Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.
 Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.
 Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.
 A bit about us: 
 🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.
 🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.
 💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.
 🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.
 💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.
 Role Overview 🔎
 We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to own the security of Orbital's product: the AI agent our customers use, the platform it runs on, and how we build both.
 Our customers are law firms and real estate businesses. They trust us with confidential transaction documents, and they ask hard questions about how we protect them. Our product is an AI agent that reads those documents, calls tools and runs code on a lawyer's behalf. That brings the usual cloud security work and a newer set of risks: prompt injection, agents acting on untrusted input, and attackers using AI to move faster than before.
 You'll be our first in-house product security engineer, taking on work we have so far relied on contractors for. You'll build security into the product rather than review it from outside: you'll decide how we rate a vulnerability and how fast we act on it, build the automated systems that find and fix issues before an attacker does, and set the security bar that engineering builds to. You'll work alongside our product engineers, with the authority to require changes across teams on security grounds, independent of any one team's delivery deadlines. An information security lead will own company-wide policy, compliance and customer assurance, and you'll work closely with them.
 You won't start from zero. Our AWS environment follows the Well-Architected Framework, with GuardDuty, Security Hub, encryption at rest and scoped credentials in place, and we hold SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments to our customers. What we need is someone to own it, find the gaps, and raise the standard as the company and the threat landscape grow.
 You'll get a chance to 👩‍💻 👨‍💻
 Build an automated security harness. Put agents to work on our product: continuous red-team and blue-team loops that probe the agent, the platform and our code, find vulnerabilities, and propose or ship the fix. Manual review should be justified when required and automatic harness improvement is expected.
 Own vulnerability management end to end. Define how we classify severity and the response time each level demands, so a critical CVE gets fixed the same day. Automate patching, dependency and image scanning, and make sure findings reach an owner and get closed.
 Secure an AI agent in production. Threat-model how our agent handles untrusted documents, emails and web content, and the tools and sandboxes it uses. Design defences against prompt injection and data exfiltration, and test them.
 Make security part of how we build. Review designs and changes that touch authentication, tenant isolation, secrets and data handling. Turn recurring findings into automated checks so the protection holds without depending on someone remembering.
 Respond to security incidents. Lead the technical response when something goes wrong: containment, investigation and the fix. Build the technical side of our breach playbooks with our information security lead, and run the review afterwards.
 Choose and run our security tooling. Evaluate and roll out a cloud security platform (such as Wiz) and the detection, alerting and logging we need across AWS and Azure. As our only product security specialist, use tooling and AI agents to cover more ground than one person could alone.
 Test our defences. Run red-team exercises, manage external penetration testers, and run breach drills with engineering so everyone knows their part before it matters.
 Close the loop on findings. Fix what penetration tests and security researchers report to us, run responsible disclosure, and keep the technical evidence for our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls current, working with our information security lead.
 Make the work visible. Show leadership and engineering what the harness finds, what has been fixed and what risk remains, in plain language, with a recommendation for each open risk.
 You should apply if you ✍️
 You build with agents. You'd rather put an agent loop on a problem than repeat a manual review. You've used AI agents to find, triage or fix security issues, and you aim for automation that leaves people to review only the exceptions.
 You have deep, hands-on security engineering experience. You've owned security for a cloud-native product or platform and can do the work yourself, from reading code and IAM policies to configuring detection and running an investigation.
 You know AWS security well. IAM, network design, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail and how they fit together in a real production environment.
 You've led incident response. You've run a real security incident, including containment, investigation, communication and the follow-up, and you stay clear-headed under pressure.
 You take application and AI security seriously. You understand OWASP-class vulnerabilities, and you're interested in the new risks that come with LLM agents, such as prompt injection and over-broad tool access.
 You understand the product and the business. You know why a finding matters to our customers and our commercial position. You can tell a theoretical finding from one that puts customer data at risk, you spend effort where the risk is real, and you don't disappear down technical rabbit holes.
 You help teams ship safely. You find the secure way to do what the team needs, and you block work only when the risk justifies it. When you do, you explain why clearly enough that engineers understand and agree.
 You work independently. As our first in-house product security engineer, you'll set your own priorities, build the programme, and know when to bring in outside help.
 You bring people with you. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, a lawyer and a board member, adjusting the detail for each, and you change how teams work through influence rather than authority.
 You'll most likely come from a security engineering, product security or application security role at a fast-growing startup, or from a security consultancy with hands-on delivery. We're open to different backgrounds if you can show the depth, judgement and automation-first approach this role needs.
 It would also be nice if you have
 Experience securing LLM or agentic AI applications, or research into prompt injection and AI-specific threats.
 Harness engineering experience: building the tooling, evaluation loops and guardrails that let AI agents do real engineering work.
 Hands-on experience with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits.
 Experience with Azure, Kubernetes or container security, or sandboxed code execution.
 Familiarity with identity and SSO providers such as WorkOS or Okta.
 Experience in legal, financial or other regulated industries.
 🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.
 💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.
 💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting . Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.
 Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

items.jobTitle: QM Qualitätsprozessingenieur FMEA Satellitentechnik Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik (w/m/d)
items.jobDescription:
**AGILIOS** ist Deutschlands moderner und sympathischer Personaldienstleister. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden mit individuellen Personalkonzepten. Dabei sind wir auf die Besetzung von Arbeitsstellen mit qualifiziertem Personal bei Unternehmen aus der Luft- und Raumfahrtindustrie sowie der Zulieferindustrie und Rüstungsindustrie spezialisiert.
Für unsere Bewerber sind wir der erste Ansprechpartner für ihre berufliche Zukunft: Wir finden den passenden Job bei renommierten Unternehmen mit langfristiger Perspektive. Unser kompetentes Team verfügt über langjährige Erfahrung und stellt mit einem innovativen Personalmanagement sicher, dass Sie
**Beruflich durchstarten. Jetzt.**
Für unseren renommierten Kunden aus der Luft- und Raumfahrtindustrie am Standort in 71522 Backnang suchen wir:
QM Qualitätsprozessingenieur FMEA Satellitentechnik Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik (w/m/d)
**IHRE AUFGABEN**
- Sie sind als **Product Assurance Manager Raumfahrtprodukte** (w/m/d) tätig
- Sie führen projektbezogene **Qualitäts**- und **Produktsicherungsaufgaben** über den gesamten **Produktlebenszyklus** durch
- Sie stellen die **Einhaltung** von **Qualitätsanforderungen** sowie relevanter **Normen**, **Richtlinien** und **Kundenvorgaben** sicher
- Sie führen Systematische **Analyse**, **Bearbeitung** und **Nachverfolgung** von **Problem**- und **Fehlerfällen** in **Entwicklungs**- und **Kundenprojekten** durch
- Sie **koordinieren** und **moderieren** **Ursachenanalysen** sowie **Ableitung**, **Umsetzung** und **Verfolgung** von **Korrektur**- und **Vorbeugemaßnahmen**
- Sie **planen**, **durchführen** und **moderieren** **Failure Mode** and **Effects Analyses** (**FMEA**) sowie **Verfolgung** der daraus abgeleiteten **Maßnahmen**
- Sie **planen** und führen präventive **Qualitätsmethoden** (z. B. **FMEA**) für **Raumfahrtprodukte** bezogen auf **Fertigungsprozesse** und **Technologien** sowie **Nachverfolgung** der daraus abgeleiteten **Maßnahmen** durch
- Sie **unterstützen** **Projektteams** bei **qualitäts**- und **produktsicherungsrelevanten** **Fragestellungen**
- Sie wirken bei internen und externen **Audits** sowie **Reviews** mit
- Sie **überwachen** die **Einhaltung** definierter **Qualitätsprozesse** und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der **Product-Assurance-Methoden**
**IHRE QUALIFIKATION**
- Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium zum Ingenieur Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik (w/m/d), Ingenieur Maschinenbau (w/m/d), Ingenieur Fahrzeugtechnik (w/m/d), Physiker (w/m/d), eine technische Berufsausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Meister (w/m/d) oder Techniker (w/m/d), ein wirtschaftliches Studium zum Wirtschaftsingenieur (w/m/d), oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Sie bringen eine mehrjährige Berufserfahrung aus dem **Qualitätsmanagement, Qualitätssicherung, Qualitätskonformität, Qualitätsprozessen, Kontrolle, Überwachung, Prüfung, Manufacturing Engineering,** **Fertigungssteuerung, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Produktionsplanung, Produktionssteuerung, Prozesssteuerung, Prozessgestaltung, Prozessmanagement** oder **Projektmanagement** vorzugsweise aus der **Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Industrie** oder der **Automotive** mit
- Sie bringen vorzugsweise Erfahrung im Bereich Product Assurance, Quality Assurance, QM Qualitätsmanagement, Durchführung und Moderation von Failure Mode and Effects Analyses (FMEA) mit
- Sie bringen vorzugsweise Erfahrung mit **Qualitätsmanagementsystemen z. B. DIN ISO 9100, PPS, 5Why, Ishikawa, APQP, PFMEDA, 8D/9S-Methodik, Mess- und Prüftechniken, Root Cause Analysis** mit
- Sie besitzen gute MS-Office Kenntnisse
- Sie haben sehr gute Englisch Kenntnisse
- Sie haben eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Sie sind team- und kommunikationsfähig
**UNSER ANGEBOT**
- Sie erhalten einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag
- Sie erhalten übertarifliche Löhne sowie Leistungsprämien
- Sie erhalten Branchenzuschläge nach GVP / BAP
- Sie erhalten Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld nach GVP / BAP
- Sie haben die Übernahmechance im Kundenunternehmen
- Sie erhalten kompetente Ansprechpartner
- Sie erhalten eine individuelle Begleitung und Beratung im Bewerbungsprozess und im Kundeneinsatz
**IHRE BEWERBUNG**
Bewerben Sie sich vorzugsweise online oder senden uns Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen per email zu.
Falls dieses Jobangebot nicht zu Ihnen passt, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Initiativbewerbung oder Sie sehen sich in unserer Jobbörse unter [http://www.agilios-personal.de](http://www.agilios-personal.de) um.

Menschen und Technologien zu verbinden, den Perfect Match für unsere Kunden zu gestalten, immer die richtigen Expert:innen für die jeweilige Herausforderung zu finden - das ist unser Anspruch bei FERCHAU und dafür suchen wir dich: als ambitionierte:r Kolleg:in, der:die wie wir Technologien auf die nächste Stufe bringen möchte. Wir realisieren spannende Projekte für namhafte Kunden in allen Technologiebereichen und für alle Branchen.
## Entwicklungsingenieur Maschinenbau (m/w/d)
**Das ist zukünftig dein Job**
* Erstellung von Einzelteil-, Einbau- und Baugruppenzeichnungen mit Siemens NX
* Pflege und Anpassung technischer Dokumentationen wie Verifikationsanweisungen
* Verwaltung projektspezifischer Confluence-Seiten und JIRA-Aufgaben
* Durchführung von Änderungsmanagement im PDM-System, z B Teamcenter
* Aufbau von Stücklisten und Erstellung von Strukturvorlagen für die Freigabe
* Konstruktive Überarbeitung bestehender Bauteile oder Baugruppen
* Unterstützung bei der mechanischen Integration von Rüstsätzen in militärische Fahrzeuge
**Deine Benefits bei uns**
* Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
* Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
* Satte Rabatte mit Einkaufsvergünstigungen, z. B. bei Reisen, Elektronik oder Autos
* Sonderurlaub für wichtige private Anlässe, z. B. Hochzeit, Umzug, Geburt
* Bis zu 30 Tage Urlaub
* Vielfältige Weiterbildungsprogramme
**Das bringst du mit**
* Abgeschlossenes Studium Maschinenbau, Fahrzeugtechnik oder vergleichbares Feld bzw Ausbildung als Technische:r Produktdesigner:in
* Berufserfahrung im Anlagen- oder Sonderfahrzeugbau wünschenswert
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Siemens NX (3D & 2D) sowie PLM-Systemen wie Teamcenter
* Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung technischer Aufgaben mit JIRA und Confluence
* Sicherer Umgang mit Stücklistenerstellung sowie Änderungsmanagementprozessen
* Kenntnisse in der technischen Dokumentation nach gängigen Standards
Unser Angebot ist wie für dich gemacht? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung - gern online oder per E-Mail unter der Kennziffer VA90-26537-KI bei Frau Jette Braun. Wir matchen: dein Potenzial und unsere Möglichkeiten. Challenge accepted? Starten wir gemeinsam das nächste Level und entwickeln die Zukunft!
